units.rawText: If you had to ask what similarities they had... they were all proud, cold people. In that world, being kind at heart in a high place is nothing but a fantasy.

units.rawText: Perhaps it is due to associating with them that my speech modules have been influenced thus, but I can't say I hate it. Keeping an appropriate distance from others is befitting of someone truly strong, no?
